title: The Uncharted Landfall
author: Elodie Brightwater
blurb: Sable Winterbourne, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
